$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-combobox__field) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

root.$why: Height: Figma lays the stroke out in Default and Disabled (2 px taller, see the manifest); the size check allows it. Radius: 8 px like Input and Select (Figma's Combobox draws 10 px with radius/lg; its Input draws 8). The padding sits on the Body and the chevron's edge distance is the field's right padding.

Body.$why: The Body takes the width the chevron leaves (Figma draws 250 or 252 px depending on the stroke); its height follows the field's.
